name: Stonesplinter Valley
summary: In southwestern Loch Modan, Stonesplinter troggs hold a mountain vale behind crude defenses. Their chieftain, Grawmug, leads the tribe from within.

sections.title: A Chittering Stronghold
sections.body:
Among the crags of southwestern Loch Modan, Stonesplinter troggs have made their stronghold. Troggs clawed up from underground across Khaz Modan and ended the quiet that once filled this hollow. The Stonesplinter tribe claimed the valley and carved crude defenses into its rocky passes.

They dug dens and raised barricades, and now hunt anything that comes too close. Their numbers threaten the roads through southern Loch Modan. So Mountaineers from Thelsamar hire mercenaries to thin the tribe and bring down Grawmug, its towering warlord.

faq.answer: Stonesplinter Valley lies in the mountains of southwestern Loch Modan, just south of the main road past Grizzlepaw Ridge.
Grawmug rules the encampment as its brutish trogg chieftain. From the deepest part of the valley, he directs raids on local travelers and patrols.

faq.q: Why are the troggs here in Loch Modan?
aliases: why are there troggs in loch modan
where did the troggs come from
faq.answer: Dwarven excavations elsewhere in Khaz Modan unearthed troggs from deep underground. Driven by senseless aggression, separate warbands came to the surface. The Stonesplinter tribe chose this secluded vale as its main staging ground.

faq.q: Why do the dwarves care about clearing the valley?
faq.answer: Stonesplinter Valley lies dangerously close to dwarf settlements, mines, and mountain roads. If the entrenched troggs go unchecked, travelers in southern Loch Modan face danger, and Mountaineer patrols face added strain.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can help the Mountaineers of Thelsamar push back the troggs and drive Grawmug's brutes from Loch Modan.
As an Alliance member, you can help secure Loch Modan's supply routes. They are vulnerable while Ironforge forces are stretched thin across the realm.
